notes.title: Neon Doomer 85 is your ticket to join the retro doomer movement.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/d8259aad166ed9198d910018bed0883c15a5d5c3.jpg[/img]

Folks!
I invite you to join the retro Doomer movement with my spin-off project to the original game called [b]Neon Doomer 85[/b].

Featuring retro-futuristic aesthetics, meditative gameplay, and an amazing retrowave soundtrack. It is already scheduled to be released in October. Free of charge.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3081180/Neon_Doomer_85/

Hurry up and watch the trailer. Add the game to your wishlist and we'll see you soon!

[previewyoutube=6-9K_2HeP-Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Join the [url=https://discord.gg/tXJ9BPkzuA]Discord[/url] server!
